steps.title: Establish Project Metadata and Base Configuration
steps.description: Establish the global package name 'com.moderncalculator.app' and configure application metadata for the premium edition.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Set up app/build.gradle with Android target SDK 34, compile SDK 34, min SDK 21, and define Java 8 source compatibility.

steps.title: Declare Application Manifest & Launcher
steps.description: Validate the Android Manifest, configure application name, orientation settings, launcher activities, and the material dark premium base theme.

steps.title: Define Advanced App Theme Colors
steps.description: Develop and add advanced palette configurations inside colors.xml, establishing premium color keys, accents, and button state color configurations.

steps.title: Create Premium Deep Space App Gradient Background
steps.description: Design bg_gradient.xml to apply a premium deep space multi-color linear gradient on the entire calculator interface.

steps.title: Design Display Gradient Panel Backdrop
steps.description: Build display_gradient.xml to construct a smooth gradient panel featuring borders and rounded corners for the calculation screen.

steps.title: Develop Luxury Loader Splash Screen Background
steps.description: Craft loader_gradient.xml with dynamic gradient profiles to set up the startup loading screen animation backdrop.

steps.title: Design Sliding History Panel Gradient Layout
steps.description: Create history_panel_gradient.xml utilizing state borders and high-end colors to host calculation formulas in the sliding drawer.

steps.title: Create Interactive History Toggle Button State Selector
steps.description: Develop history_btn_bg.xml to handle state feedback on clicks when showing or clearing computation logs.

steps.title: Create Operator Button State Styles
steps.description: Construct high-contrast electric-blue state selector backgrounds for prime calculation keys.

steps.title: Design Action Key Rounded Backdrop Selector
steps.description: Produce dark-gray active color state handlers for backspace, percent, sign-switch, and clear controllers.

steps.title: Define Number Button Selector State Map
steps.description: Implement rounded slate backgrounds and custom feedback states for digits zero through nine.

steps.title: Design Equals Master Selector Style Map
steps.description: Integrate premium active neon orange selections to style the calculator result completion trigger.

steps.title: Construct Premium Layout Hierarchy with Loader and History Drawers
steps.description: Implement activity_main.xml, building a complex overlapping structure containing the gradient screen background, calculation board, history overlay, and launch loader.

steps.title: Develop Mathematical Computation and State Tracking Engines
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java skeleton declarations, mapping button events, and laying out variable states.

steps.title: Integrate Premium Audio Synthesizer and Tactile Feedback Module
steps.description: Implement haptic vibration feedback and program a ToneGenerator tone synthesizer in MainActivity.java to play unique click chirps.

steps.title: Build Calculation Persistence Module & Splash Animations
steps.description: Develop automated splash loader timeout routines, add scale touch click animations, and build SharedPreferences formula history tracking.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Verify and build the premium version of Modern Calculator using Gradle 8.5 to produce the final Android app bundle.
